verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a 'Search UI Components' section heading in the official install docs, which suggests first-party UI components exist. Nothing describes what they contain or how they assemble a working interface. The live demos (songs search, geosearch) show full search UIs built on Typesense but do not show reusable component libraries. Missing for 10: documentation of specific components (search box, hits/results, facet refinement, pagination), framework coverage (React/Vue/vanilla), installation or usage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a full interface with them.
